scope: 2025 CCPC Zhengzhou B G I J M
limitations: Independent small-case checks only; no online judge submissions or maximum-size runtime tests.

B.method: all integral cutting-plane choices for random small boxes versus forced sorted ranks and joint 3D buckets

G.method: original integer-operation BFS, bounded by the monotone high binary block, versus nonnegative block Dijkstra

I.method: all permutations n<=7 to recover record-value set frequencies, followed by direct per-set sampling probabilities for k<=20

J.method: all four corner-generating values in [0,15], random arrays, and highest-bit carry boundary versus explicit XOR matrix

M.method: every binary string of length3..15 and random long strings versus every legal operator position using exact integers
